aws.name: region
aws.doc: The AWS region to deploy into.

aws.name: variablesKey
aws.doc: ARN of a KMS key to encrypt this account's variables under. Omit it and ocel bootstrap --features variables-key makes a key ocel owns.

gcp.name: project
gcp.doc: The Google Cloud project to deploy into. Omit it and ocel reads GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, CLOUDSDK_CORE_PROJECT, then the credentials and gcloud config. ocel cost scan reads no credentials and runs no gcloud, so it needs the project here or in one of those two variables.

gcp.name: region
gcp.doc: The region to deploy into. A project spans them all, so this names the one.

vps.name: deployKey
vps.doc: Path to the public key the ocel-deploy login accepts; defaults to the bootstrapping login's keys.

vps.name: proxy
vps.doc: What fronts this machine on ports 80 and 443. Leave it out and ocel runs its own proxy; name the one the machine already runs to deploy behind it.

vps.name: ssh
vps.doc: The machine to deploy onto: a Host alias from ssh_config, or the destination spelled out.
